Our matcha is trusted by global brands thanks to our rigorous quality control and internationally recognized certifications. Whether you require matcha for beverages, supplements, or food production, we meet the highest industry standards for safety, traceability, and consistency.We source directly from certified producers in Japan and China, ensuring full transparency across the supply chain. Our matcha is tested for heavy metals, pesticides, and microbiological safety, and meets or exceeds global compliance standards.

‍Certifications include:
JAS (Japanese Agricultural Standard)
EU Organic
USDA Organic
HACCP & FSSC 22000
Independent Lab Testing
Kosher Certification

🟢 Learn more about our quality process or request lab reports for your compliance needs.
